Scale any recipe up or down to the exact number of servings you need. Convert between cups, grams, ounces, milliliters, and more. Find ingredient substitutions when you're missing something. Get estimated nutrition per serving.

ingredientcalculator_com.first_comment:
Hey everyone! I built Ingredient Calculator because I was tired of doing recipe math in my head every time I wanted to halve or double a recipe.

The core features:
- Scale ingredients to any serving size (not just 2x or 0.5x — any number)
- Convert between metric and imperial cooking units instantly
- Find substitutions when you're out of an ingredient
- See estimated nutrition per serving

Everything runs in the browser. No data leaves your device. Would love to hear what features you'd want next!

recipetool_net.tagline: Calculate nutrition for any recipe — calories, macros, free
recipetool_net.description:
Recipe Tool is a free recipe nutrition calculator that gives you instant calorie and macro breakdowns for any recipe.

Enter your ingredients, set the number of servings, and instantly see calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, and sodium — both total and per serving.

No signup, no app to download, no subscription. Just paste your ingredients and get the numbers.
recipetool_net.first_comment:
Hi everyone! I built Recipe Tool because existing nutrition calculators are either locked behind subscriptions (MyFitnessPal), overly complex (Cronometer), or require creating an account just to check one recipe.

How it works:
1. Add your ingredients (with autocomplete for common foods)
2. Set quantities and units
3. Set number of servings
4. Get instant nutrition breakdown: calories, protein, carbs, fat, fiber, sodium

All free, all in the browser. What recipes are you going to analyze first?
